correctness.rationale: Complete facet enumeration and all 10,491 faces from normalized PG(2,3) coordinates; exactly 4,875 verified elementary collapses yield a 2-dimensional complex with 26 vertices, 208 edges, 507 triangles. value.rationale: This is the first non-Fano projective plane and a natural next finite test of the scale-three metric-graph Čech construction. The scale-three complex is intrinsically seven-dimensional yet has a two-dimensional simply connected collapse; its exact 324-sphere multiplicity is not supplied by published scale-four all-order classification, order-two Heawood data, or clique-Rips results. The precise integral homotopy type is a reusable benchmark for projective-incidence Čech persistence and possible all-order extensions; the claim remains restricted to the proved finite instance.
